plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.6-sol). Blocking: (1) container CPU must come from cpu.stat deltas normalized by effective CPUs, not os.cpus() -> now reported as a separate cgroup series with throttling counters; (2) cgroup discovery must resolve /proc/self/cgroup and walk ancestors, handling v2 max + v1 sentinels -> implemented via cgroupPathsFromProc + tightest-limit walk; (3) cloud-session capture was manual-only -> preflight.sh now emits a session-start headline snapshot; (4) final-only report loses data on timeout/cancel -> samples stream to a JSONL sidecar and the CI report step rebuilds via --from-jsonl. Non-blocking addressed: host vs cgroup memory terms separated, swap + PSI pressure added, --once defined as a two-snapshot measurement, counters converted to rates before summarizing (gauges only), artifact name carries label+run attempt and report is if:always()+continue-on-error, fixture tests cover nested/unlimited/malformed/fractional-quota/cpuset cases, hostname and RUNNER_NAME deliberately not collected. Not adopted: per-process attribution and disk-IO throughput (scope); install-phase profiling (sampler needs node_modules) is documented as an explicit scope limit.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation is exceptionally well-reasoned and robust. It correctly separates physical host metrics from cgroup limits, handles namespaces and v1/v2 layouts, and elegantly falls back on incomplete samples via the jsonl sidecar. Code is thoroughly tested, deeply commented, and fully adheres to repo guidelines.
